meta.purpose: Turn strategy development into a competition whose winner is chosen by evidence rather than by narrative. The board is the governance device that decides which hypothesis gets compute, data spend and - last - capital.
meta.entries_explanation: The board is empty because it is honest. A leaderboard row requires a settled or priced bet record per strategy; no bet record and no price feed exist in this repo. Populating this table with plausible-looking numbers would be the single most damaging thing this project could do to itself, because the board's whole purpose is to be trusted.

primary.name: Luck-adjusted CLV score
primary.definition: score = (mean CLV in cents per bet) x sqrt(n) / (1 + overfit_penalty), where overfit_penalty = log(1 + variants_tried_in_family) from the decision journal, and n is capped at the sample gate.
primary.why: It rewards a real, reproducible price advantage and punishes a family in which many variants were tried to find it. It can be computed the day a bet settles, which is the point.

secondary.name: Risk-adjusted growth
secondary.definition: log-growth of a fractional-Kelly bankroll on the realised results, reported only after the sample gate passes; displayed greyed with 'not yet significant' before then.
secondary.why: Money is the final argument, but it is a slow and noisy argument; showing it without the significance marker invites exactly the luck-chasing the brief forbids.

tiebreakers: Stability across sub-periods (lowest variance of the primary metric across weekly blocks)
Robustness score from G-7 (fraction of edge retained under input perturbation)
Capacity at target stake from G-4
never: recency of a hot streak

tiers.name: Registered
tiers.requirement: Pre-registered hypothesis, inputs named, missing inputs declared, gates listed.

tiers.name: Backtest
tiers.requirement: G-1..G-5, G-9, G-11 pass on a frozen run with recorded config+data hashes.

tiers.name: Paper-live
tiers.requirement: Tier 1 plus a forward paper run of at least one full season-week block with real timestamps and real fill assumptions.
tiers.consequence: priority in the ingestion queue; small non-cash reward

tiers.name: Capital-eligible
tiers.requirement: Tier 2 plus G-4, G-6, G-8, G-10, G-12, G-13, G-14 pass and reviewer sign-off on budget.
tiers.consequence: may receive a capped allocation, one strategy at a time

tiers.name: Quarantine
tiers.requirement: any G-14 violation, any G-9 violation, or a kill-switch trigger in G-15.
tiers.consequence: suspended, evidence preserved, cannot be re-submitted under the same id

promotion_rules: A strategy may not skip a tier and may not be promoted inside an in-progress week.
Promotion is decided by the gate runner's output file, not by a person reading a page; a person may only veto, never override upward.
Re-registering a killed strategy under a new id is a G-14 violation; the journal records the family so the rename is visible.

A strategy whose required input is unavailable is not 'failing' - it stays at Tier 0 with blocked_on populated, and the block is surfaced on the questions page so it is a procurement task rather than a scoreboard loss.

rewards.design_rule: Reward the behaviour that produces information, not the behaviour that produces action.

grants.reward: Historical price-data spend for that family, and first claim on the next ingestion slot
A named allocation review with the reviewer, and a raised weekly cap in the paper book
Capped live allocation, subject to Q-RISK-01 and Q-LEGAL-01
grants.gate: reviewer sign-off required; the board never moves money by itself (Q-GOV-03)

grants.reward: Award for the cleanest disproof of a popular idea (published in the journal, kills a bad strategy early)
grants.why: Without this, the contest rewards only belief and the catalogue fills with unfalsifiable stories.

explicitly_not_rewarded: anything measured before the sample gate

anti_gaming.rule: Append-only, hash-chained bet ledger; a strategy that edits history is quarantined, not corrected.
Hypothesis must be timestamped before the first bet in that family (min_hours_between_hypothesis_and_first_bet, value pending).
Max 3 bets per game per strategy; duplicate bets on the same side/price by two strategies of the same owner collapse into one for scoring.
Every row must carry a re-readable price source; a row whose price cannot be re-verified is void and stays void.
Minimum stake floor equal to the target live stake; sub-threshold bets do not count toward n.
Promotion and demotion are logged with the gate output hash.

worked_example.label: SYNTHETIC ARITHMETIC DEMONSTRATION - NOT A RESULT. Numbers below are invented to show the formula is well-defined. They must never be quoted, screenshotted, or copied into any decision.
worked_example.read: A second strategy at 6 cents CLV over 520 bets but with 1 variant tried scores 6 x 22.8 / 1.69 = 80.9 and outranks it by ~4x, which is the intended behaviour: a clean, cheap, un-tortured edge beats a bigger number found by trying eight things.
worked_example.why_included: To make the scoring auditable before any real entry exists, so the reviewer can reject the *metric* while it is still free to change.
